_help: Funnel benchmarks for brain jobs rank (stage weights). Sources in docs/research/job-search-evidence.md section 1: inbound application-to-interview about 3% (Ashby Talent Trends), referred 40%; interview-to-offer about 6% inbound and 16% referred. 'respond' blends inbound with some outreach; 'interview' is first response to a real interview; 'offer' is interview to offer.
